title: Portfolio, final-year project and job readiness
summary: Turn projects into evidence for your chosen track (AI Engineer, FDE or MLOps), scope and run a final-year project with pre-registered evaluation, and prepare for hiring: DSA, SQL, timed system-design practice (concepts live in M22), debugging and paper interviews, open-source contribution, resume and behavioural stories. Job readiness runs in parallel from year 2.

You can prove reproducibility by having a stranger set it up from scratch.

capstone.title: Final-year project plus job-ready portfolio
capstone.brief: Deliver an FYP that is useful to real users with a pre-registered, held-out evaluation, an independent technical report reviewed by another person, and a portfolio matrix complete for your track; pass at least one mock interview.

levels: 3: real users, adoption/feedback data, problem validated in discovery
3: strong baseline, pre-registered held-out eval, ablations, cost/latency, failure analysis
3: one-command setup, CI, deployment runbook, monitoring (MLOps track: rollback demo)
3: portfolio matrix complete for the chosen track
3: reviewed report, published case study, 5-minute demo, mock interview passed
